evidence: This picturesque destination, nestled beside the majestic West Lake, has undergone a remarkable transformation from a barren lotus pond and reed bed to a lush, blooming "flower valley" in the 2010s. The name itself symbolizes the aspiration to create a peaceful and vibrant oasis amidst the imperial city.
